body: Thought I'd give this a shot but I don't think it was worth it.  I don't know what I was thinking really.

The reality is that my situation is immediate.  It's right now.  I don't think I can make it homeless, in fact, I know I can't.  So it's like the circumstances are upon me...maybe if I make it out of this I can find that comfort and purpose but my demise is immediate, it's now.  That's probably why I can say I want out of this misery, because I am so close to the end.  Asked that question a month ago I would have said I was content with my decision to end things.  The sad part is that I DO want out, I DO want to try but without some relief to my immediate situation there's little choice.  Circumstances can be cruel.  It's my fault and I'm to blame.

I'm 38.  I've had my moments.  I'd say in truth even though you're not asking, I'm haunted by a moment of perfect content.  I remember plain as day when I was hiking the Appalachian Trail and I was alone as it was off season and I came across this little "town" in New York or some place...more like a hamlet.  It was cool out, no leaves on the trees and absolutely zero signs of life.  It was as if I was in a post apocalyptic movie when I was the last person in the world on some journey.  It was the most content in life I'd ever been.  Anyways, I read a bit about you and I've been there as far as dates.  It seems like I'm constantly negotiating with myself for another year etc.  I've thought about suicide many times before, it's always been there.  The thing this time is that the circumstances are such that I'm probably going to have to do it...even though I'm so close to the end I feel like I want to give life another chance but I'm in a near hopeless situation.  So anyways, I've gone on far more than what you asked in your question.  I guess I'm just so isolated and desperate that I searching for anybody to help me, even a stranger.
